notes:
Improvements:

- Dorcel TV no longer uses the experimental 10-second InputStream Adaptive live delay after the previous test showed more Kodi-side buffering warnings without a clear playback benefit.
- Dorcel planned token handoff now accepts a wider real-stall window so the required ISA reopen can occur at the end of an already-visible Dorcel stall instead of as a separate blink whenever possible.
- New WiFi diagnostics periodically log interface, signal strength and link quality during playback so future logs can distinguish stream/server issues from local wireless conditions.
- Settings time labels are simplified back to 1 h and 2 h while the internal 65-minute and 125-minute long-check windows remain unchanged.

Bugfixes:

- Restores native keyboard/remote navigation between vertically arranged Settings tabs: Up/Down changes tabs, Right enters the selected tab and Left returns to the tab list.

Important:

- The proven long-check runtime, check lock, AlarmClock, watchdog, log-copy, Save Log Only and shutdown safety logic remain unchanged.
